title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1991-09-17
source: This is a matrix of these sources: SBD: shnid=12847 (SBD: DAT> CD> EAC> SHN) // DAUD: shnid=97390 (B&K 4011 110∫ ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro)

ai_review.summary: A solid matrix recording captures a tight 1991 show highlighted by strong Samson and an elegant Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: Reviewers praise this 1991 performance for its tight bandwork, noting Jerry Garcia's focused playing and a particularly powerful second solo on Samson. Both "Samson" and the mellow intro to "Eyes of the World" are singled out as stand‑outs, and the matrix mix is appreciated for delivering a clear, immersive listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average ~4.3) and strong positive comments about both the performance and the matrix recording justify a rating in the upper‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners thank the matrix engineers for a well‑balanced mix; no major sound issues are reported, suggesting clear and listenable audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly with tight interplay, a strong Samson solo, and a mellow yet effective introduction to Eyes of the World.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Playing described as focused and not listless; second solo on Samson highlighted as strong.
